scope: One bounded research question and its local analysis artifacts

canonical_sources.owns: Direct observations, original data, and primary sources
Accepted question, scope, and publication decisions

gates.required_evidence: Cited primary evidence with explicit inference and material uncertainty

secrets.routine_access: restricted material remains in its approved source system
secrets.delivery: approved viewer or analysis process without model-visible values
secrets.artifact_scan: publication disclosure scan with non-revealing output
secrets.exposure_response: notify the material owner without repeating the material
secrets.clean_context: fresh analysis context after confirmed path closure
secrets.encrypted_envelopes: forbidden unless the destination alone controls decryption

program.trigger: persistent study with dependent questions, collection, and publication gates
program.repair_authority: research sponsor independent of the invalidated study control

policy.reporting: cited answer with source strength, inference, and uncertainty
